message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: Theft of 7 guihua trees from a company's orchard, using digging method, value 5400 yuan. The act is secret theft, not violent. So it's 盗窃 (theft). The amount is 5400 yuan, considered relatively large? In Chinese law, theft of property over certain amount qualifies as "数额较大". So charge is 盗窃.

Any other charges? They dug up trees, maybe "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物"? But the trees are guihua (osmanthus) not necessarily protected. The list includes "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物". Not applicable unless the trees are protected species. Not indicated.

Also "破坏生产经营"? Not exactly. They stole trees, not damage to production.

Thus only 盗窃.

Check if there is "抢夺"? No violence, they dug and stole, not force. So 盗窃.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
